FERC Order 1000 classifies reliability, economic, and public policy projects as those identified by the regional transmission provider as necessary to satisfy reliability standards, reduce congestion, and meet transmission needs driven by public policy requirements established by state or federal laws and regulations, respectively (FERC 2011). Multivalue projects provide some combination of these benefits. These categories of projects are identified through regional transmission planning processes. By contrast, local and generator interconnection projects have generally been identified outside of the regional planning process. Local transmission projects are identified by incumbent transmission providers to meet local needs. Generator interconnection projects are identified through grid studies associated with new interconnection requests.7 Table 3.
